title: Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) / Hypervisor-Enforced Code Integrity (HVCI) is Disabled
description: VBS uses hardware virtualization features to create an isolated subsystem that hosts security solutions including HVCI and Credential Guard, blocking kernel-mode tampering.
impact: Adversaries exploiting vulnerable kernel drivers (BYOVD attacks) can execute unsigned code directly in ring 0.
remediation_guidance: Enable Memory Integrity / HVCI in Windows Security Settings or set HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity\Enabled = 1
